entries.title: II Chronicles 34:2
segments: Piety in early youth saves from many troubles, and is a preparation for great enjoyment and usefulness in riper years.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:3
segments: He bagan to purge Judah and Jerusalem; the work was not completed till the eighteenth year of his reign.  Compare
.  It is this final purging that is recorded in

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:5
segments: True reformers will treat vice with abhorrence, and endeavor in all suitable ways to render it contemptible.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:8
segments: The preparation of suitable houses, and the regular establishment of public worship, is one of the essential means of general and permanent reformation.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:12
segments: That could skill of instruments of music; that were skilful in playing upon the instruments used in the temple.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:14
segments: If the Scriptures are lost, or the people are not in the habit of reading or hearing them, great degeneracy and wickedness will follow; and there is no way of effectually reclaiming men, but in bringing them to an acquaintance with the word of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:21
segments: All who truly believe the Bible, will be anxious to know what they must do to escape that wrath of God to which on account of their sins they are exposed.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:28
segments: Although the true penitent shall not perish, he may nevertheless be exposed to a violent death.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:31
segments: When rulers take the lead in reformation, many may be expected to follow, and to continue externally in the ways of the Lord as long as those in authority set them the example.

entries.title: II Chronicles 34:33
segments: Made all--to serve; made them conform externally to what was required in the law of Moses.
